title: uuencoding::UuError is missing PartialEq — makes testing and matching harder for downstream
description: uuencoding/src/error.rs: UuError derives only Debug, not PartialEq or Eq. Downstream code that wants to assert_eq!(err, UuError::BeginBase64) or use UuError as a map key cannot. The test code in this crate itself uses matches!() instead of == precisely because PartialEq is absent. MultiUuError (which wraps UuError via DecodeError) similarly cannot derive PartialEq as a consequence. This generates a class of user frustration: 'why can't I compare UuError values?' The fix is trivial since all variants contain only String, usize, and u8.
acceptance_criteria: Derive PartialEq (and Eq) on UuError and MultiUuError. Update any test that uses matches!() for equality to use assert_eq! where appropriate.
close_reason: Derived PartialEq+Eq on UuError and MultiUuError; updated simple matches!() to assert_eq!() where possible
